title: Turbofan · Structure preview
attribution: Geometry by Dmitry Kulikov · jet-engine-3d · MIT
scope: An educational turbofan interpretation inspired by the CFM56-7B. This preview retains 11 structure modules with reduced blade surface sampling. It is not manufacturer CAD. The motions illustrate virtual module relationships; they are not an approved maintenance or removal sequence.

parts.title: Nacelle
parts.detail: The outer intake and nacelle surround the front of this educational model.

parts.title: Fan module
parts.detail: The large front fan is shown with its surrounding case and guide vanes.

parts.title: Low-pressure compressor
parts.detail: The booster follows the fan on the path into the core.

parts.title: High-pressure compressor
parts.detail: Rows of compressor blades occupy the forward part of the core.

parts.title: Combustor
parts.detail: The annular combustion section is between the compressor and turbines. No flame simulation is included here.

parts.title: High-pressure turbine
parts.detail: This turbine module is directly behind the combustion section.

parts.title: Low-pressure turbine
parts.detail: The rear turbine module contains several blade rows in this simplified geometry.

parts.title: Exhaust assembly
parts.detail: The rear frame and exhaust geometry sit behind the turbine modules.

parts.title: Core cowl
parts.detail: The cowl surrounds the smaller central core in the assembled model.

parts.title: Shafts and supports
parts.detail: The shaft group runs along the engine axis between the front and rear modules.

parts.title: Accessory group
parts.detail: The accessory gearbox and associated shapes sit beside the core.

steps.title: Reveal the engine structure
steps.instruction: Separate the virtual outer nacelle, core cowl and accessory group to reveal the modules inside.

steps.title: Follow the front modules
steps.instruction: Watch the fan and compressor groups spread along the engine axis. Select each group to see its name.

steps.title: Locate the combustion section
steps.instruction: Look between the compressor and turbine groups for the combustion section. Rotate the view to compare its position with the surrounding modules.

steps.title: Explore the rear modules
steps.instruction: Spread the turbine and exhaust groups to see their order along the axis. This is a virtual structure illustration.

steps.title: Find the shafts and supports
steps.instruction: Select the shaft group and rotate the model. Compare the long central shaft shapes with the separated front and rear modules.

steps.title: Reassemble the virtual engine
steps.instruction: Replay the model groups returning to their assembled positions. Use the part menu or exploded view to explore again.
